response.description:
The Mdsv4
and Msv4 Series are memory-optimized virtual machine series built on 6th
Generation Intel® Xeon® Scalable processors and enhanced with advanced security
capabilities and the latest Azure Boost technologies. Designed for
demanding memory-intensive and mission-critical workloads, including SAP
workloads, these new series deliver improved performance, scalability,
efficiency, and reliability to help customers run large-scale enterprise
applications more cost-effectively. Learn more:  Announcing
Public Preview of new Mv4 Medium Memory Virtual Machines | Microsoft Community

Medium Memory size series (Preview) - Azure Virtual Machines | Microsoft Learn
response.title: Public Preview: Mdsv4 and Msv4 Series Virtual Machines for SAP
